figma.name: Fare Optimizer (Optimization)
figma.note: layers renamed to m-* roles 2026-10-15 (names only, geometry unchanged, ADR 0039); the export is the Optimization instance 761:9492 (480x377) inside the working frame 761:9491 (480x480, the instance sits at y=52); the price line, axes and labels stay as drawn (no motion in Figma)

export.how: Figma export SVG with 'Include id attribute', sent by the team; then (1) the <mask> of the panel title moved into <defs> (technical edit: the preparation tool removes ids outside <defs>; rendering unchanged); (2) colours replaced by the nearest existing tokens (option B, by precedent, 2026-10-15): #034152 -> #013746, #33CAAF -> #2ABDA3, #979797 and #999999 (gradient ends with opacity 0, invisible) -> #CBD2D1. Figma itself was not changed. Embedded noise PNG re-encoded losslessly as an indexed PNG. Original: source/figma-export.raw.svg.
